# Vendored ComputerCraft libraries

## pixelbox_lite

Source: https://github.com/9551-Dev/pixelbox_lite  
License: MIT (see `pixelbox_lite.LICENSE`)

Used for multi-color sixtel (teletext `\128`-`\159`) rendering on the memory-map monitor.
The LCD painter uses the same 2×3 sixtel character encoding for 1bpp frames.
